nodes.description: Interior shot of the Mall of Berlin (Eastside Mall), a modern upscale multi-level fashion shopping mall. The image is taken from an elevated balcony perspective showing multiple retail floors with glass railings, a dramatic arched glass-and-steel roof skylight flooding the atrium with natural light, and prominent fashion retail storefronts including Zara and H&M. The ground floor atrium features palm trees, white modular seating, and shoppers browsing. The mood is bright, aspirational, and contemporary — evoking premium high-street fashion retail. Used as a static background fallback on the auth page when the background video cannot play (e.g., on mobile devices).
